assertion: At least one span generated by the instrumented API reached Jaeger via otel-collector after the k6 run.
notes: Spans exported over OTLP/gRPC from the API to otel-collector, forwarded to the local Jaeger all-in-one. products.list is an explicit ActivitySource span; GET /api/v1/products and GET /health come from ASP.NET Core auto-instrumentation.
